duplicatedSetNames.setName: Japanese レイジングサーフ

members.verdict: CORRECT — SV3a really is レイジングサーフ / Raging Surf
WRONG — relabelled to シャイニートレジャーex / Shiny Treasure ex

duplicatedSetNames.resolution: sv4a relabelled; sv3a left as it is.

correction.was: Japanese レイジングサーフ
correction.now: Japanese シャイニートレジャーex
evidence: UPSTREAM ERROR, NOT OURS. api.tcgdex.net/v2/ja/sets/SV4a returns setName レイジングサーフ while returning SV4a's CORRECT release date 2023-12-01 and its CORRECT card count 320. The same API returns that same name for SV3a, which is the set that really bears it.
SV3a is a 92-card set released 2023-09-22; SV4a is a High Class Pack released 2023-12-01. Different sets, different sizes, different dates.
THE ROWS WERE ALREADY RIGHT. Our sv4a file holds 367 rows numbered 1-354 — Shiny Treasure ex's shape, not Raging Surf's 92. Only the label was wrong, so no row changed.
Confirmed independently against the Japanese market: ハイクラスパック「シャイニートレジャーex」SV4a, 2023年12月1日発売.

whyItMattered: setName is what a human reads when auditing a cell. Two set codes sharing one name is the condition under which someone reconciles them into a single product and merges two real sets' pools.
